candidate: Normal initial Maker Hooks common-pool ownership state
rationale: Normal setup expressly puts all four Maker Hooks tokens in the bank. This determines a player permission, rather than merely a convenient component layout: the Hooks prerequisite is possession of a token on that player's garrison, not availability of a token in the bank. The normal setup therefore does not grant any human that prerequisite. A later acquisition moves a token from the bank to the acquiring player's garrison. The initial ownership state is not directly requested anywhere in the complete final bank.

proposed_question: In normal standard human setup, where do the four Maker Hooks tokens begin: in the common bank or already assigned to players? Where does a token go when a player later acquires it?
proposed_key: Place all four Maker Hooks tokens in the common bank. Normal setup does not assign a Hooks token to any human player. When a player acquires one, take it from the bank and put it on that player's garrison; that is the possession required by a Maker Hooks prerequisite.

source_references.supports: All four Hooks in the common bank during normal setup.
Take an acquired token from bank to own garrison; a Hooks prerequisite requires a token on that garrison.
